plan.summary: BRO-5088 class sweep: Director credits that belong to another production or another role, and Playwright credits held by non-writers (each sourced in the action description).
steps: once-2012: drop Director credit for John Carney (wrote and directed the 2007 film only; John Tiffany directed the stage production) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Once_(musical))

the-apple-tree-2006: drop Director credit for Mike Nichols (directed the 1966 original; the 2006 Roundabout revival was directed by Gary Griffin) (https://www.newyorktheatreguide.com/theatre-news/news/the-apple-tree-kristin-chenoweth-to-star)

a-midsummer-nights-dream-1996: drop Director credit for Sue Lefton (credited for movement direction, not director (IBDB search snippet)) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/a-midsummer-nights-dream-4272)

my-fair-lady-1993: drop Director credit for Moss Hart (Original Production Director (1956); 1993 revival directed by Howard Davies) (https://playbill.com/production/my-fair-lady-virginia-theatre-vault-0000005237)

jekyll-and-hyde-1997: drop Director credit for Gregory Boyd at The Alley Theatre (directed the 1990 Alley Theatre production; Broadway directed by Robin Phillips) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jekyll_%26_Hyde_(musical))

private-lives-2011: drop Director credit for Scarlett Mackmin (credited for movement direction (IBDB search snippet); Richard Eyre directed) (https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Broadway-Bound-PRIVATE-LIVES-Begins-Rehearsals-822-20110819)

funny-girl-2002: drop Director credit for Garson Kanin (directed the 1964 original (died 1999); this one-night 2002 benefit concert was directed by Peter Flynn) (https://playbill.com/person/peter-flynn-vault-0000019513)
arcadia-1995: drop Director credit for Jane Gibson (Movement Director; Trevor Nunn directed) (https://playbill.com/production/arcadia-vivian-beaumont-theatre-vault-0000011241)
electra-1998: drop Director credit for Jonathan Butterell (credited for movement direction (IBDB search snippet); David Leveaux directed) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/electra-5701)
irene-1973: drop Director credit for John Gielgud (hired for the tryout and replaced by Gower Champion before Broadway) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Irene_(musical))

romeo-and-juliet-2013: drop Director credit for Nancy Bannon (movement direction; David Leveaux directed) (https://www.newyorktheatreguide.com/theatre-news/news/romeo-juliet-complete-cast-and-creative-team-announced)

good-evening-1973: drop Director credit for Joe McGrath (Film Sequences Directed by; Jerry Adler directed the stage show) (https://playbill.com/production/good-evening-plymouth-theatre-vault-0000009582)
butley-1972: drop Director credit for Harold Pinter (directed the London original and the film; Broadway directed by James Hammerstein) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butley_(play))

on-the-waterfront-1995: drop Director credit for Gordon Edelstein (Playbill Vault credits Adrian Hall as the only director; no source credits Edelstein) (https://playbill.com/production/on-the-waterfront-brooks-atkinson-theatre-vault-0000008004)

something-unspoken-1995: drop Director credit for Loyd Williamson (IBDB snippet credits only Theodore Mann as director; no source for Williamson as director) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/garden-district-4306); drop Director credit for Harold Scott (IBDB snippet credits only Theodore Mann as director; no source for Scott as director) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/garden-district-4306)

caesar-and-cleopatra-1977: drop Director credit for Al Sambogna (IBDB and NYPL credit only Ellis Rabb as director; no source for Sambogna) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/caesar-and-cleopatra-3897)
alice-in-wonderland-1982: drop Director credit for Bambi Linn (movement credit only (CSM); directed by Le Gallienne and John Strasberg) (https://www.csmonitor.com/1982/1230/123003.html)
mame-1983: drop Playwright credit for Peter Wolf (scenery designer (CSM review of the 1983 revival); Lawrence and Lee wrote the play) (https://www.csmonitor.com/1983/0727/072701.html)
shenandoah-1989: drop Playwright credit for Reginald Bronskill (no source for a writing credit; IBDB credits James Lee Barrett with the book) (https://www.csmonitor.com/1989/0815/lshen.html)

the-glass-menagerie-1983: drop Playwright credit for Michael Dansicker (no source for a writing credit; the play is by Tennessee Williams) (https://playbill.com/production/the-glass-menagerie-eugene-oneill-theatre-vault-0000004708)

the-little-foxes-1981: drop Playwright credit for Stanley Silverman (a composer, not a writer of this play; Lillian Hellman wrote it (BRO-5080 synopsis author gate)) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/the-little-foxes-4117)

the-suicide-1980: drop Playwright credit for Trinity Square Repertory Company (a producing company, not a person; Nikolai Erdman wrote the play) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/the-suicide-3970)
sweet-sue-1987: drop Playwright credit for Kodak Duratrans (a Kodak display-film product, not a person; A. R. Gurney wrote the play) (https://www.ibdb.com/broadway-production/sweet-sue-4438)
